name: @shieldfont/react
description: ShieldFont React component: encodes in Node so your original text never ships to the browser. Harms accessibility by design — a protected block fails WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 even with every a11y feature on, because the real words are unavailable until the reader completes a 5-20s JavaScript unlock. Don't use it on content covered by the ADA, Section 508, the European Accessibility Act/EN 301 549 or the UK Equality Act 2010, or by any WCAG conformance claim.
author: Isaque Seneda and Gabriel Abrucio
